0x5E.description: Small food: restores a little HP. Collectable consumable; touching it applies the effect. Collecting a placed one (unk2/unk3 not the default) adds 1 to the room's collected counter gUnk_02023510.

params.name: appearance
params.description: Small food only: copied to unk83, the sprite variant (which food is drawn).

params.name: spawnMode
params.description: How the bonus enters play. 0 = placed: y is snapped down onto the 16-px cell floor, the twinkle sparkle is attached (unless unk22 bit 2) and it waits to be touched. The non-zero modes are used by run-time spawns (chests, enemies, Kirby), never by room data: 1 = hidden inside Kirby and popped out when his animation reaches 0x69; 2 = pops out upward (yspeed 0x180); 3 = created inert; 4 = sub_08123924. Any non-zero mode also blinks from frame 240 and despawns at frame 360.

0.name: placed
0.description: static pickup, snapped to the floor cell

evidence.note: placed: snap to floor
non-zero modes time out at 360 frames

evidence.data: subtype2 is 0 in every retail placement of 0x5E..0x64

params.name: bonusFlags
params.description: Bit field. Bit 3 (8) is the only one the retail data uses heavily (~40% of placements): the item floats where it is placed, with no gravity and no terrain collision (ObjectBase flags 0x40 = no gravity, 0x100 = no tile collision; see ObjectMain). Without it the item drops to the floor. Bit 0 (generic, types 0..0x64) counts the pickup towards the room's "defeated" counter when the object dies with hp <= 0; bit 1 (generic) makes it collide with solid objects; bit 2 suppresses the twinkle sparkle.

bits.name: countsAsDefeat
bits.description: Generic for types 0x00..0x64: when the object is destroyed with unk80 (hp) <= 0, add 1 to the room's defeat counter gUnk_02023508 (read by OBJ_OBJECT_SPAWNER and OBJ_TRIGGERABLE_WALL). On a bonus this is effectively inert: collecting sets the counter-B (collected) path instead.

evidence.data: set on 1-2 items (rooms 823, 121, 202, 414), all otherwise ordinary

bits.name: collidesWithSolidObjects
bits.description: Generic for types 0x00..0x64: sets ObjectBase.unkC 0x1000, which makes ResolveSolidObjectCollision push this object out of solid objects (blocks).

bits.name: noSparkle
bits.description: Do not attach the twinkle effect (sprite 0x2BB) to a placed item.

bits.name: floating
bits.description: Float in place: no gravity, no tile collision. Clear = falls to the ground and rests on it.

evidence.note: no gravity (object.c sub_0809D1E0 skips yspeed -= 5)
gravity only when flag 0x40 clear
tile collision only when flag 0x100 clear

params.description: Not read by CreateBonus or any bonus state function (no reader in game/src for this type). The rare 256/512 values look like leftovers of the enemy record the item was copied from.

The marker sprite shows whether that (room, x, y) edge is in the room's used-door list (sub_08002BA8 over gUnk_08D640A4 / gVisitedDoors).
